title: Ultrafiltration and Liquid-Liquid Extraction of Steroids from Serum
author: Anna Mazurenko
materials: Discard of methanol glassware rinse waste
Obtain ice bucket with wet ice
Thaw serum samples gently on wet ice

steps.title: Prepare Glassware and Reagents
steps.instruction: Clean and prepare all necessary glassware and solutions before starting the extraction.

substeps.instruction: Rinse two 20 mL scintillation vials, a 500 mL Duran bottle, and three 500 mL beakers with HPLC-grade methanol; repeat the rinse twice.
Dry the rinsed scintillation vials, Duran bottle, and beakers (e.g., in a fume hood).
Fill the rinsed 500 mL Duran bottle with 500 mL of fresh MilliQ water.
Prepare 10 mL of 50% HPLC-grade methanol (diluted with MilliQ water) in a rinsed 20 mL scintillation glass vial.
Prepare 20 mL of 25% HPLC-grade methanol (diluted with MilliQ water) in a rinsed 20 mL scintillation glass vial.
Rinse two sets of 12x75 mm glass culture tubes twice with 1 mL of HPLC-grade methanol (vortex for 2s each time), dry upside down in an oven at 60°C for 10 min, and cover with aluminum foil.
Label the first set of rinsed/dried 12x75 mm glass culture tubes as 1a, 2a, 3a, ..., n a and the second set as 1b, 2b, 3b, ..., n b.
Cover glass LC-MS/MS vials with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Samples
steps.instruction: Warm the necessary equipment and thaw the biological samples and standards.

substeps.instruction: Warm the water bath to 37°C.
Prewarm the centrifuge (Avanti J-15R, Beckman Coulter) and rotor adaptors to 37°C; spin at 2000 g if necessary to warm per manufacturer instructions.
Thaw standard curve standards (0.02 pg/µL - 400 pg/µL) and internal standard mix (10 pg/µL) on the bench top to reach room temperature.
Gently thaw filtered and non-filtered serum samples (stored at -70°C) on wet ice.

steps.title: Perform Ultrafiltration of Serum
steps.instruction: Separate free steroids from serum using ultrafiltration devices.

substeps.instruction: Label one ultrafiltration device (#4104, Sigma-Aldrich) per serum sample and remove the red reservoir caps.
Place thawed serum samples in a 37°C water bath for 10 min.
Pipette at least 30 µL of serum into each ultrafiltration device, ensuring >5 µL of serum is reserved for total steroid measurement.
Centrifuge devices at 2000 g at 37°C for 1 hr.
While centrifuging, add 5 µL of the reserved serum to labelled Bead Ruptor (BR) tubes for total steroid measurement.
Transfer the entire ultrafiltrate from the filter collection tubes to new BR tubes for free steroid measurement.
Discard used ultrafiltration devices according to institutional biohazard policies.

steps.title: Prepare BR Tubes for Extraction
steps.instruction: Set up the BR tubes with beads and appropriate standards/controls.

substeps.instruction: Obtain BR tubes (Fisher Scientific, Cat # NC0934160) containing five 1.4 mm ceramic oxide beads for standard curve, quality control, blank, and double blank samples.
Label sealed 0.6 mL polypropylene microcentrifuge tubes to correspond with all BR tubes.
Place glass inserts into glass LC-MS/MS vials.
Add 10 µL of standard curve standards (0.02 pg/µL - 400 pg/µL) to respective BR tubes.
Add 10 µL of low concentration (0.2 pg/µL) and high concentration (20 pg/µL) quality controls to respective BR tubes.
Add 10 µL of 50% HPLC-grade methanol into blank BR tubes to equalize volumes.
Add 50 µL internal standard mix (10 pg/µL) to all BR tubes except double blank tubes.
Add 60 µL of HPLC-grade 50% methanol into double blank BR tubes to equalize volumes.

steps.title: Liquid-Liquid Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract steroids using ethyl acetate and a bead mill homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 1 mL HPLC-grade Ethyl Acetate to all BR tubes.
Vortex all BR tubes for 2 sec.
Homogenize samples at 4 m/s for 30 sec using a bead mill homogenizer (Fisherbrand Bead Mill 24, Cat # 15-340-163).
Centrifuge samples at 16,100 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove 1000 µL of supernatant and transfer to the labelled 12x75 mm glass culture tubes (1a, 2a, etc.).
Add 500 µL MilliQ water to all samples and vortex for 5 sec.
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 2 min at room temperature.
In a fume hood, carefully remove the top ethyl acetate layer and transfer to the second set of glass culture tubes (1b, 2b, etc.).

steps.title: Sample Recovery and Final Processing
steps.instruction: Dry the extract and resuspend it for LC-MS/MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Preheat water bath to 65°C in the fume hood.
Dry the ethyl acetate samples in the 65°C water bath for 8 min with N2 gas.
Resuspend dried samples with 200 µL 25% HPLC-grade methanol.
Vortex for 5 sec to ensure resuspension.
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer the whole volume to the corresponding 0.6 mL polypropylene microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 16,100 g for 2 min at room temperature.
Transfer 150 µL of supernatant to the glass LC-MS/MS vial inserts.
Cap vials, ensuring no air bubbles are present.

steps.title: Storage and Analysis
steps.instruction: Store processed samples or inject into the mass spectrometer.

substeps.instruction: Store samples in glass LC-MS/MS vials at -20°C until injection.
Inject 35 µL of each sample into the LC-MS/MS system according to manufacturer's guidelines.
